stories.title: First Minister recalls Buckley Tivoli in grassroots music debate
stories.summary: Buckley’s Tivoli was named in the Senedd as an MS called for VAT to be scrapped on gig tickets to help grassroots music venues. Marc Jones MS (Plaid Cymru, Fflint Wrecsam) raised the venue during First Minister’s questions on Tuesday. stories.title: Flintshire Council enforcement team issued just two dog fouling fines last year
stories.summary: Flintshire Council’s enforcement team issued just two fines for dog fouling in 2025/26, figures show, as the council prepares to renew its dog control rules. stories.title: Flintshire Council to pay Coleg Cambria’s costs after losing Connah’s Quay pitch appeal
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has been ordered to pay Coleg Cambria’s full appeal costs after councillors refused plans for an all-weather football pitch against the advice of their own officers. stories.title: Toyota says Deeside is its first carbon-neutral plant outside Japan
stories.summary: Toyota’s engine plant in Deeside has started running on gas and electricity from a neighbouring waste plant, in what the company says is the start of carbon-neutral production. stories.title: Senedd rejects Reform bid to scrap default 20mph limit
stories.summary: The Senedd has rejected a Reform UK motion calling on the Welsh Government to scrap the default 20mph speed limit, by 51 votes to 37.
